notes: ἀγαθοποιῆσαι and κακοποιῆσαι each head on the sense-bearing complement (*good*, *harm*) rather than on the support *do* (rules 17, 91).
σιωπάω → *held their peace* is one unit headed on *peace*, the competing head on *held* being named in the unit note.
Ἔξεστιν → *Is it lawful* keeps the supplied subject and copula on the predicate word under rule 68, the clause expressing no subject.
